acceptance_gate.condition: held-out predictive AUROC reported AND frozen 0.9131 ensemble unchanged AND Exp 2837 rounded memory contribution >= +0.0185 AND Tier-3 predictor state persisted
acceptance_gate.principle: Tier-3 may be weaker than the scorer, but it must be a real additive predictor and must not regress the banked discriminator.

field_principles.duration_s: Wall-clock plausibility floor; verifier-scoring + a small CPU JAX train is modest.
field_principles.headline_ensemble_unchanged: BARE bool, true -- the frozen 0.9131 scoring ensemble is UNTOUCHED; Tier-3 adds a predictive head, it does not replace the discriminator.
field_principles.honest_verdict: Terminal prefix; the self-learning outcome; blocked_<resource> if a precondition failed.
field_principles.inference_substrate: verifier_ensemble_against_cached_candidates (principle: reads cached verifier scores, no live model).
field_principles.is_tier3_not_tier1_or_tier2: BARE bool, true -- confirms v19 is Tier-3 predictive verification, NOT a re-run of v17 (Tier-1) or v18 (Tier-2).
field_principles.memory_contribution_preserved: BARE bool -- the +0.0185 fr11_session_memory contribution survives (the load-bearing invariant).
field_principles.model_specs: Names the corpus + 4 verifiers + the JEPA predictor -- honest substrate.
field_principles.predictive_auroc: The Tier-3 predictor's held-out AUROC -- the core deliverable; reported honestly even if below the full ensemble.
field_principles.tracker_state_persisted: BARE bool, true -- the Tier-3 predictor was persisted so a future milestone resumes it (continuous, not one-shot).
field_principles.train_test_split_sizes: Sample-size hygiene -- the held-out split sizes so the AUROC is interpretable (and leakage is auditable).

inference_substrate: verifier_ensemble_against_cached_candidates (principle: reads cached verifier scores, no live model).

preconditions_checked.detail: online graph fit, graph learner, and fixed crossfit baseline importable
